name: Akiflow
summary: Planner that consolidates tasks and calendars, with an AI assistant for time-blocking.
description: Akiflow collects tasks from other apps into one inbox, lets users time-block them on their calendars and includes an AI assistant that answers scheduling questions and books slots. It targets founders, operators and busy professionals. A seven-day free trial is offered; the Pro plan costs $19 per month or $16 per month billed yearly, with a student discount. Integrations bring tasks in from other apps into a single inbox.

howToUse.title: Open Akiflow
howToUse.description: Go to Akiflow and choose Try for free. The trial lasts seven days and is aimed at founders, operators and busy professionals.

howToUse.title: Collect tasks and time-block them
howToUse.description: Turn on integrations from other apps. Akiflow collects those tasks in the inbox, then you time-block them on the calendar.

howToUse.title: Ask the assistant to book a slot
howToUse.description: Ask the assistant scheduling questions so it books slots. If you stay, Pro is $19 a month, or $16 a month when billed yearly, and there is a student discount.
